text: I feel a sense of anticipation and curiosity in this space. The clean, modern architecture, glass walls, and organized layout invite reflection about the boundaries between public and private, openness and seclusion. The R+D display strikes me as a celebration of human creativity and intellect, suggesting that I am amidst a place dedicated to discovery and growth. There’s an undercurrent of innovation here, and I am eager to explore how ideas are nurtured and shared in such an environment.
